title: Asynchronous rollback broker and customer triage for mixed-deployment model regressions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: During recent canary promotions we observed asymmetric regressions affecting a subset of tenants across Hosted/Dedicated/Private environments. Manual rollback orchestration is slow, error-prone, and leads to late customer escalations. This ticket defines an "asynchronous rollback broker" pattern and customer-facing triage flow to coordinate safe rollbacks, KV cache reconciliation, and consistent comms across deployment modes. Goals: 1) Automate decision handoff across control planes (hosted -> dedicated -> private) so rollbacks are triggered reliably and idempotently. 2) Provide tenant-aware scoping to avoid collateral impact. 3) Surface clear customer liaison messages with estimated timeline and remediation steps. 4) Reduce mean time to safe-state for regressions by 60% in the next quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Broker can receive a single rollback intent and fan out idempotent rollback commands to hosted, dedicated, and private control planes within 60s
Rollback operations include KV cache invalidation or reconciliation hooks and verify no stale KV reads after completion
Tenant-scoped rollbacks supported: ability to target traffic slices, account-level pinning, or global model pin
Built-in customer comms templates available in Console with per-tenant ETA variables
Playbook unit tests and integration test harness covering cross-env rollback choreography are added to CI
Runbook and post-mortem template updated; runbook tested in two scheduled fire drills
